archived_at.title: Archived At
archived_at.description:
RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate was archived, or
`null` if it is not archived.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate was registered.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description:
RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate expires, or
`null` if it does not expire.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: The certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint, as a lowercase hex string.

tunnel_id.title: Tunnel Id
tunnel_id.description: ID of the Tunnel this certificate is registered against.

type.title: Type
type.description: Object type. Always `tunnel_certificate` for Tunnel Certificates.
